tool_input.command:
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(seed): scope additive repair to archetypes only; decline symlinked dest

Two Copilot findings on PR #526, decisions made, one commit.

1. RESTRICT to archetype category. decide() is shared by every scopeEthos
   destination, so without a category gate, a user who deliberately deleted
   a shipped top-level key from an untracked role, pipeline, or bundle-
   scoped identity would find it silently re-added forever — additiveMerge
   can prove a diff is additive but not that an absent key was never
   removed on purpose. GH #525, the doctor guard, and the operator ruling
   are all archetype-specific; the code now matches. A new repairCandidate
   bool is threaded from each seedFS call site (only the archetypes call
   passes it true; every other category — roles, talents, personalities,
   writing-styles, pipelines, agents, bundle content, skills — passes
   false) through place/classifyExisting/decide to the point where decide
   would otherwise call repairAdditive. Named constants (repairCandidate/
   notRepairCandidate) instead of bare booleans at call sites. Test: an
   untracked role missing a shipped field, same additive shape as the
   archetype case, stays plainly skipped with no SkipReasons entry —
   proving the category gate, not additiveMerge declining on its own
   (that path stays covered by the existing TestAdditiveMerge_* tests).

2. SYMLINK decline. repairAdditive now os.Lstat's dest before touching it:
   os.Stat (used for reading content and for mode preservation) follows a
   symlink to its target, but atomicWriteMode's os.Rename operates on
   dest's own path — renaming a regular file over a symlink destroys the
   link itself, not the file it pointed to. A symlinked archetype now
   declines the same way a never-was-a-candidate file does (empty reason,
   no SkipReasons entry) before any read or write is attempted. Test:
   a symlinked archetype declines, the link survives intact, and the
   target's content is untouched.

docs/seed-content-upgrade.md: tightened every "strictly additive schema
gap" / "untracked skip-category files" mechanism sentence across the
decision table, the "Spelled out" list, the 2026-09-19 ruling section, and
the ADR-proposal block to name archetypes explicitly, since the mechanism
is no longer category-general. Added "Why 'provably additive' content
shape is not enough on its own — the category gate" and "Why the repair
declines a symlinked destination" subsections to the ruling explaining
both new decisions.
EOF
)"

        try: json.loads(l)

    for i in lines:

        if "tool_input_preview" in obj: obj["tool_input_preview"] = ""

        ls[i-1] = json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",",":"))
